eligibility_rule: non-finite margin: unconditional reference failure (NONFINITE_REFERENCE_MARGIN); finite negative margin: unconditional reference/order-consistency failure (NEGATIVE_REFERENCE_MARGIN); finite zero margin: eligible exact-tie stress case; finite positive margin: eligible
historical_inputs_forbidden: no v1/v2 observed margin or selected-case identity may be used as a v4 selection input
margin_definition: min over all 8 greedy decisions of fp32(top1_logit - top2_logit)
selection_rule: sort finite nonnegative margins by (margin,case_id); take first four and last four
